scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run bundle:android && npm run bundle:ios
scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --entry-file index.ts --platform android --dev false --bundle-output dist/android/index.android.bundle --assets-dest dist/android --sourcemap-output dist/android/index.android.bundle.map
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --entry-file index.ts --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output dist/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/ios --sourcemap-output dist/ios/main.jsbundle.map
scripts.native:ios: xcodebuild -workspace ios/Weave.xcworkspace -scheme Weave -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
